rationale: Both responses correctly square the inequality to get 4 < t < 12.25 and count the 8 integers from 5 to 12. A gives the reason squaring is allowed, namely that every part of the inequality is positive. It also checks the boundary cases: sqrt(4) = 2 is excluded, sqrt(12) < 3.5 is included and sqrt(13) > 3.5 is excluded, which guards against off-by-one mistakes. B notes that t >= 0 but never explicitly ties this to why squaring preserves the inequality, and it does not check the endpoints. A's reasoning is slightly more careful.
